name: Pipeliners - Supporting Blog Keyword Research 2026-09-18
body:
> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-09-18

# Summary
Kim asked whether old merged posts could become supporting blogs for the pages they redirect to. Source: Search Atlas lookups and the website pages tracker (113 pages).

# Answer
No. The old posts already were supporting blogs; Google skipped them because they repeated topics other posts cover, and the old URLs had no rankings or links. Write new supporting posts on uncovered topics instead.

# Gaps worth a new post
- orangeburg pipe (8,550 / KD 33)
- clay sewer pipe (1,223 / KD 21)
- replacing galvanized steel pipes (480 / KD 13), written without prices

# Checked and skipped
pinhole leaks in copper pipes (already covered), roots cluster (covered by 2 posts), how long does pipe lining last (38, and lifespan needs Scott), homeowners insurance sewer line (55, KD 52), who is responsible for the sewer line (23), how long does trenchless sewer repair take (0), epoxy safe for drinking water (0).

# Suggested order
Orangeburg, then clay sewer pipe, then galvanized pipes.
